ai_summary: ADF Foods Limited is investing in a 950 KWp rooftop solar plant at its Surat manufacturing facility, expected to meet approximately 46% of the site's energy requirements and lower electricity costs. This CAPEX project, to be commissioned by year-end, signifies a material positive step in the company's broader ESG initiatives, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and reduce its carbon footprint. The document presents no immediate red flags, detailing a strategic investment aligned with sustainability goals following a similar renewable energy project at another facility.
